Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring record checks for developmental disabilities service providers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to record checks for developmental disabilitiesservice providers; and adding a new section to chapter 71A.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71A.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All persons who provide services under this chapter and who willhave unsupervised access to persons with developmental disabilities arerequired to submit to a record check through the Washington statepatrol criminal identification system under RCW 43.43.830 through43.43.834, 10.97.030, and 10.97.050, and through the federal bureau ofinvestigation. The record check shall include a fingerprint checkusing a complete Washington state criminal identification fingerprintcard. The requesting entity shall provide a copy of the record reportto the applicant. When necessary, persons may be employed on aconditional basis pending completion of the investigation. If theapplicant has had a record check within the previous two years, theagency may waive the requirement.
